subject: Mutual action plan & POC environment: Concordia Labs — org/API/IP/VPC
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@concordia-labs.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@concordia-labs.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan and POC environment — Concordia Labs

Markus — thanks for the intro call this morning. Concordia is ready to move forward with a 2-week POC focused on inference latency for our chart summarization pipeline. Before we lock dates, we need clarity on the environment dependencies so we can schedule infra and security approvals on our side. High-level asks from Concordia: 
- Org creation + an initial admin user for our cloud tenant
- Ephemeral API keys for testing (non-prod scope)
- IP allowlist entries (we'll provide CIDRs)
- VPC peering or VPN for private egress to Redwood Private (if needed)

Can you share a concrete mutual action plan with owners and dates? Procurement is cc'd for contract window visibility. We aim to start network connectivity by Tue Feb 24 if that's feasible.

Thanks,
Ethan Cole
Head of Integrations — Concordia Labs
Attachments: Concordia_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@concordia-labs.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and POC environment — Concordia Labs

Ethan — appreciate the quick follow. Draft MAP attached with owners and a two-week cutover cadence. High-level plan we propose: 
1) Org + admin: Redwood creates Concordia tenant and adds the contact you specified. Owner: markus_klein. Target: Thu Feb 20.
2) API keys (ephemeral): Generate scoped keys for non-prod with 72h TTL. Owner: priyom_das. Target: Feb 20–21.
3) IP allowlist: Submit your CIDRs in the format below; we will add to the safe list and confirm. Owner: neha_kapoor. Target: Feb 22.
4) VPC peering: Exchange peering request + route table entries; we can do a peer validation on Feb 24. Owner: neha_kapoor. Target: Feb 24 (connectivity test).
5) Smoke tests & acceptance: Basic token issuance + 1k-token throughput smoke run. Owner: priyom_das. Target: Feb 25.

I've attached the MAP workbook that breaks these into tasks and acceptance criteria. If Concordia can send the CIDR list and preferred admin account by end of day tomorrow, we can hit the Feb 24 connectivity milestone.

Quick note on security: we will only allow peering to a customer-designated VPC and require a short questionnaire to be returned (attached).

Best,
Markus Klein
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_Concordia_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@concordia-labs.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:31:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and POC environment — Concordia Labs

Ethan — quick technical checklist from infra/security so you have clear requirements: 
- IP allowlist format: CSV with columns (label, cidr, owner_email). Example row: 'concordia-dev,10.12.48.0/22,netadmin@concordia-labs.com'
- For VPC peering we need: your VPC ID, AWS account ID, region, and list of route table IDs to update.
- If you prefer VPN instead, share the external gateway IP and PSK mechanism; we can support both but peering is lower-latency.
- MTU: 1400 recommended for gRPC streaming stability; please note if your infra requires 1500.

I'll action the allowlist as soon as the CSV lands. Also tagging priyom for API key generation notes (policy scopes).

-Neha
Network & Integrations — Redwood Inference
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@concordia-labs.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@concordia-labs.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and POC environment — Concordia Labs

Team — attached the CIDR export and our proposed admin user. We prefer VPC peering (lower latency). Key details in the CSV include two dev subnets and a staging subnet; we want the dev subnets peered first. We can confirm route tables by Monday. Proposed start for connectivity work: Tue Feb 24.

Quick answers: 
- VPC ID: vpc-0c4a2b8f9d3e1a2b
- AWS account: 123456789012
- Region: us-west-2
- Preferred MTU: 1400
- Admin: ethan.cole@concordia-labs.com (IAM admin for the tenant)

I'll fill out the attached security questionnaire this afternoon.

Thanks,
Ethan
Attachments: Concordia_Network_CIDRs.csv (csv)
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@concordia-labs.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and POC environment — Concordia Labs

Ethan — thanks for the CSV and the admin details. Quick status update and next actions (closing the MAP items):
- Org + admin: Tenant created and ethan.cole@concordia-labs.com invited as org-admin. (Done)
- API keys: Created two ephemeral API keys (scope: generation + embeddings, TTL: 72h). Keys delivered via encrypted channel. Owner: priyom_das. (Done)
- IP allowlist: neha added dev CIDRs to the allowlist at 10:48 PST this morning. (Done)
- VPC peering: peering request submitted to your account; acceptance pending on your side. Once accepted we'll update route tables and run the connectivity smoke test. Target smoke window: Wed Feb 25 09:00–11:00 PST.

Runbook for the smoke test: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqK-example-MapAndRunbook (see 'smoke-test.md'). HubSpot deal: HS-987654321.

Please confirm acceptance of the peering request when you see it so we can flip the testing window open. Procurement — thanks for staying in the loop.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Platform Operations — Redwood Inference
